test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: Who was sent to foreign countries to preach Buddhism by Emperor Ashoka?
solution: **S**anghmitra was the daughter of emperor Ashoka and his wife Devi. Together with Mahinda , her brother, she entered an order of Buddhist monks. The two siblings later went to Sri Lanka to spread the teachings of Buddha.
